mapper.select: SELECT A.slug AS slug, 0 AS viewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT AF.user_id) AS favoriteCount, COUNT(DISTINCT C.id) AS commentCount, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(A.created_at)) AS INTEGER) AS daysSincePublished FROM articles A LEFT JOIN article_favorites AF ON A.id = AF.article_id LEFT JOIN comments C ON A.id = C.article_id WHERE A.slug = #{slug} GROUP BY A.id

SELECT A.slug AS slug, A.title AS title, A.description AS description, COUNT(AF.user_id) AS favoriteCount FROM articles A INNER JOIN article_favorites AF ON A.id = AF.article_id WHERE AF.article_id IN ( SELECT article_id FROM article_favorites WHERE article_id IN ( SELECT id FROM articles WHERE created_at >= #{since} ) ) AND A.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY A.id ORDER BY favoriteCount DESC LIMIT 10
